title: PawFund Animal Welfare Donation Platform - Frontend Implementation

requirements.summary: Design and apply warm, compassionate visual theme with earthy tones, friendly typography, and card-based layouts
acceptanceCriteria: All pages share a consistent color palette using earthy/warm tones
Typography is readable and friendly-looking
Card-based layouts are used for campaigns and donor information
No inconsistent or clashing color usage across pages

file_operations.description: Define CSS custom properties for warm amber (#D97706, #F59E0B), soft greens (#10B981, #34D399), and creamy whites (#FFFBEB, #FEF3C7). Add global styles for card shadows and rounded corners.
Extend the Tailwind theme to include custom colors (warmAmber, softGreen, creamyWhite) and configure rounded typography with friendly font families. Set default border radius for cards.
Create a Layout component that wraps all pages with consistent warm-toned background, navigation bar with logo, and footer. Apply earthy color scheme and rounded typography throughout.

requirements.summary: Implement donor registration and profile management with Internet Identity authentication
acceptanceCriteria: Donors can register and log in via Internet Identity
Profile page displays name, avatar, email, and total donated amount
Donors can edit their display name and contact email
Profile data is persisted in the backend

file_operations.description: Use the authorization component to implement login/logout functionality with Internet Identity. Handle authentication state and clear query cache on logout. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Use the authorization component to create a modal that appears when a new user logs in without a profile. Collect display name, profile picture URL, and contact email. Call saveCallerUserProfile to persist. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Use the authorization component to create a custom hook that fetches the current user's profile using getCallerUserProfile. Handle actor availability and prevent flash of profile setup modal. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Use the authorization component to create a mutation hook that saves the current user's profile using saveCallerUserProfile. Invalidate the currentUserProfile query on success. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a profile page displaying the donor's nickname, avatar, email, and total donations. Include an edit form for updating display name and email. Use card-based layout with warm tones. Guard this page to require authentication.
Wire the ProfileSetupModal to appear after login when user profile is null. Add route for /profile page. Ensure authentication check wraps protected routes.

requirements.summary: Implement animal welfare campaign listings with filtering and detail views
acceptanceCriteria: A browsable list of campaigns is shown on the home/discover page
Each campaign card shows title, category, cover image, progress bar, and amount raised vs goal
Clicking a campaign opens a detail page with full description and donation CTA
Campaigns can be filtered by category and status (active/completed)

file_operations.description: Create a query hook that fetches active campaigns using getActiveCampaigns. Return array of AnimalCampaign objects.
Create a query hook that fetches all campaigns using getAllCampaigns. Return array of AnimalCampaign objects for filtering by status.

Create a card component for displaying campaign summary: cover image, title, category, progress bar (amountRaised/fundraisingGoal), and amounts. Use warm-toned card styling with rounded corners and gentle shadows. Make clickable to navigate to detail page.
Create a filter component with dropdowns/buttons for animal type categories and active/completed status. Style with earthy tones.

Create the home page displaying the hero banner at frontend/public/assets/generated/pawfund-hero.dim_1200x400.png above a grid of CampaignCard components. Include CampaignFilters. Fetch campaigns using useGetActiveCampaigns or useGetAllCampaigns based on filters. Use warm color scheme throughout.

Create campaign detail page showing full campaign info: cover image, title, description, category, dates, progress tracking (see REQ-7), and donation form. Use card layout with warm tones. Route parameter for campaign ID.
Add routes for / (Home) and /campaign/:id (CampaignDetail). Wrap app with Layout component for consistent navigation.

requirements.summary: Implement donation submission for campaigns with authentication requirement and success confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: Donors can enter a custom donation amount and submit it on any active campaign's detail page
Donation is recorded in the backend with all required fields
Campaign's 'amount raised' is updated immediately after donation
A success confirmation is shown to the donor after donating
Anonymous (not logged in) users are prompted to log in before donating

file_operations.description: Create a mutation hook that calls submitDonation with campaignId and amount. Return transaction reference ID on success. Invalidate campaign queries to refresh amount raised.

Create a form component with amount input, validation, and submit button. Check authentication status before submission; prompt login if not authenticated. Call useSubmitDonation on submit. Style with warm tones and rounded inputs.
Create a success modal displaying confirmation message, transaction reference ID, and donated amount. Style with warm color palette.
Integrate DonationForm component. Show DonationSuccessModal after successful donation. Ensure form is disabled for completed campaigns.

requirements.summary: Implement recurring donation support with toggle option and cancellation from profile
acceptanceCriteria: Donation form includes a toggle/checkbox for 'Make this a monthly donation'
Recurring donations are stored with frequency and next-due date
Donor profile lists active recurring donations with campaign name and amount
Donors can cancel a recurring donation from their profile

file_operations.description: Create a mutation hook that calls submitRecurringDonation with campaignId and amount. Invalidate recurring donation queries on success.
Create a query hook that fetches recurring donations using getRecurringDonations. Return array of Donation objects with isRecurring=true.
Create a mutation hook that calls cancelRecurringDonation. Invalidate recurring donation and profile queries on success.
Add a toggle/checkbox for recurring donation option. Conditionally call useSubmitRecurringDonation instead of useSubmitDonation when toggled. Style toggle with warm colors.
Create a component listing active recurring donations with campaign name, amount, and cancel button. Use card styling. Call useCancelRecurringDonation on cancel action.
Add RecurringDonationsList component to the profile page below user info. Fetch data using useGetRecurringDonations.

requirements.summary: Implement donation history page with chronological listing and receipt view
acceptanceCriteria: Donation history page is accessible from the donor's profile
Each entry shows campaign name, amount donated, date, and transaction reference
Entries are sorted newest-first
A 'View Receipt' action shows a receipt detail view with all donation info

file_operations.description: Create a query hook that fetches donation history using getDonationHistory. Return array of Donation objects sorted by timestamp descending.
Create a component displaying donation history in card format. Each entry shows campaign name, amount, date, and transaction reference. Include 'View Receipt' button. Style with warm tones.
Create a modal displaying receipt details: transaction reference, campaign name, amount, date, donor name. Style as a printable receipt with warm branding.
Create donation history page displaying DonationHistoryList. Fetch data using useGetDonationHistory. Guard page to require authentication. Use card-based layout.
Add route for /donation-history page. Add navigation link from Profile page to donation history.
Add a 'View Donation History' link/button that navigates to /donation-history.

requirements.summary: Implement campaign progress tracking view with visual progress bar, donor count, and days remaining
acceptanceCriteria: Progress bar visually fills based on amount raised / goal
Percentage, total raised, and goal amount are displayed numerically
Total donor count is shown
Days remaining is calculated and displayed for campaigns with an end date
Recent donors section lists up to 10 most recent donor names

file_operations.description: Create a component displaying campaign progress: visual progress bar (percentage filled), numeric percentage, total raised, goal amount, and days remaining. Calculate days remaining from endDate. Style progress bar with warm amber fill and soft green background.
Create a component listing up to 10 recent donors by name. Fetch donation history and filter by campaign, then display donor names. Handle anonymous donors. Style with card layout.
Integrate CampaignProgress and RecentDonors components into the campaign detail page layout. Position them prominently near the donation form.

requirements.summary: Render generated hero banner and app logo as static assets in header and home page
acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in the top navigation bar on all pages
Hero banner is displayed prominently on the home/discover page
Images are loaded from frontend/public/assets/generated/

file_operations.description: Add the logo image at frontend/public/assets/generated/pawfund-logo.dim_256x256.png to the navigation bar header. Ensure it appears on all pages via the Layout wrapper.
Add the hero banner image at frontend/public/assets/generated/pawfund-hero.dim_1200x400.png at the top of the home page above campaign listings. Use full-width display with proper aspect ratio.
